items.title: Share profiles within your Enterprise workspace
items.text: Enterprise workspace members can share their profiles with coworkers, including activity and Sites they choose to showcase. Workspace owners control whether profiles and activity are available and whether profiles are visible only to their owners or to other workspace members. Shared Enterprise profiles are limited to members of the same workspace. Adding a Site to a profile does not change who can access that Site. Shared profiles do not show conversation titles or content.
